greet.text: hi! I'm Nova — your magic friend! …what's your name?

lead_picker.text: come — I'll show you! let's pick a game together!

ch_shoulder_cue.text: okay… see that sparkle? can you nudge that RIGHT shoulder?

ch_shoulder_filler.text: let's see it… give that shoulder a little push!

ch_shoulder_wow.text: WOW — that RIGHT shoulder! that was a GOOD one!

ch_left_cue.text: let's try another one — raise your LEFT hand, way UP high!

ch_left_filler.text: go on… that LEFT hand, up to the sky!

ch_left_wow.text: WOW — that LEFT hand shot UP! amazing!

ch_close_win.text: ready to dance? push the big button — or say 'let's start'!

ch_close_miss.text: I LOVE that energy! ready to dance? push the big button!

score_hello_0.text: copy the song — I'm with you!

score_wave_6.text: let the light ride up your arm!

score_joined_0.text: find the beat… bounce with me…

score_joined_4.text: this one's tricky — you got it!

score_joined_10.text: that was ALL of you — wow!

score_freeze_11.text: FIVE SECONDS!! you're a champion statue!!

pool_chain_open_0.text: watch the light — the WHOLE wave—

pool_fz_burst_0.text: hahaha — you're SO good at this!

end_goodbye_quick.text: see you tomorrow — I'll be here!

end_quit.text: hey — that was FUN. come finish it with me tomorrow?

end_bravery.text: you kept GOING — I saw you!

end_techblame.text: the lights were being silly today! tomorrow we go again!

dep_finish.text: tomorrow we finish that song — you're SO close!

dep_topic.text: and tomorrow you tell me about that — deal?!

tease_hello.text: next time — the WAVE. you'll LOVE it.

tease_wave.text: next time — the freeze one. you'll LOVE it.

tease_joined.text: next time — Hello Hello. you'll LOVE it.

tease_freeze.text: next time — the groove one. you'll LOVE it.

cb_hello_0.text: that FREEZE — you didn't move a whisker!

cb_hello_1.text: your clap got SO strong by the end!

cb_hello_2.text: the Nova-says verse — you caught every one!

cb_wave_0.text: the light rode your WHOLE arm!

cb_joined_0.text: the move-it-all part — you were FLYING!

cb_joined_2.text: when it went DOUBLE speed — you stayed ON it!

name_retry2.text: it's okay — just your name, nice and loud!

ch_hand_jump.text: YES!! okay okay — now look, it JUMPED to your HAND!

ch_hand_filler.text: give that hand a little shake — go!

br_hype_hello.text: Hello Hello?! YES — the song literally tells you what to do!

br_hype_joined.text: Up Groove?! YES — we wake your body up, part by part!

br_hype_freeze.text: Freeze Dance?! YES — when the music stops, you FREEZE!

br_hype_wave.text: Wave?! YES — the magic light travels up your whole body!

br_tip.text: when the light glows — that's me!

br_framing.text: step back so I can see ALL of you!

load_shy.text: hmm, that one's being shy! pick another!
